en-US.name: Martha Meals
en-US.summary: Leave a note for Martha, your household's meal planner.
en-US.description: A private skill for one household. Say how a meal went, what you're out of, or what you'd like more of; Martha files it at the next planning run.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Martha Meals to note that we're out of ground cumin
Alexa, use Martha Meals to note that the chili was a hit
Alexa, ask Martha Meals to note that Sam liked the tacos

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Private household skill; not for publication.
